title: Kitty/iTerm2/Ghostty graphics

kitty_command: Oracle semantics: 'm' honored only for direct medium; z/H/V parsed as i32 bitcast; single-char non-digit values stored as ASCII; unknown keys ignored; signed/unsigned overflow errors; delete range requires x<=y and both present; unknown action -> InvalidFormat
kitty_load: Direct, file, temporary-file (tempdir+naming validation, delete-after-load), shared-memory (shm_open/fstat/range-validation/unlink) transports
Bounds: per-image max_size=400MB, max_dimension=10000, chunked accumulation capped at max_size
File blocklist: /proc, /sys, /dev except /dev/shm; POSIX NUL rejection; regular-file requirement; offset/size bounded reads
placement: Scroll semantics: placements anchor to absolute rows; viewport scroll is host-side; prune_history(boundary_row) removes scrolled-out placements; resize is geometry-parameter-only
store: Deterministic eviction: priority (transient+unused < unused < transient+used < used), then generation, then image id; byte budget and count budget
Generation stamps: process-global monotonic u64; every content mutation marks dirty + bumps; retransmit replaces image and deletes its placements

Execute semantics: quiet filtering (q=0 all non-empty, q=1 errors only, q=2 never), chunked quiet inheritance, implicit ids never reply, delete never replies, animation actions -> 'ERROR: unimplemented action', disabled storage (limit 0) refuses everything
Cursor movement after placement C=0: rows bounded by terminal height, col = pin.col + cols + 1 (saturating)
iterm: ItermUploads{feed -> Option<CompletedUpload>} with DEFAULT_MAX_IN_FLIGHT=16 and per-upload max bytes
glyph: RequestParser + Request::{Support,Query,Register,Clear}; Register options cp/fmt/reply/upm/aw/lh/width/size/align/pad with defaults and last-value-wins
Response::{Support,Query,Register,Clear}::encode with exact wire bytes; Coverage; Reason codes
GlyphEntry::from_register (fmt validation, nonzero metrics, constraint normalization) + validate_simple_glyf (no composites, no hinting, monotonic endpoints, checked deltas)
Glossary::register/delete/clear_and_free/contains with FIFO eviction at 1024 and PUA-only namespaces
texture: Deterministic LRU eviction (last_used, then sequence, then handle id); single-entry over-budget rejection
Consumable by GPUI without another renderer: handles are opaque; host maps them to GPU textures
host: NoopHost and RecordingHost (tests); S6 mr-crabs-protocols dispatcher implements GraphicsHost at integration

acceptance: All S7 manifest entries are covered by production code in mr-crabs-graphics and focused behavioral tests

s7-graphics.json contains provenance-cited oracle cases and fixture hashes for reply bytes, placement metadata, decoded pixel hashes, malformed/oversized rejection, transport cleanup, iTerm2 parsing, and glyph APC replies

Every allocation and file-size path is bounded: command buffers (kitty 65MiB default, glyph 1MiB), image data (400MB), decode output (400MB), storage bytes (320MB) and placements (2^18), iterm uploads (16 in flight), glyph payload (64KiB) and glossary (1024 entries), texture cache (bytes+count)
Temporary-file transport deletes the file after loading; rejection happens before cleanup is armed; shared-memory objects are unlinked
Cache eviction is deterministic (documented priority/age/id order) and tested for byte and count budgets
Reply bytes match the frozen corpus byte-for-byte; decoded pixel hashes match the independently computed corpus hashes
No Sixel implementation exists anywhere in the crate
No GUI launch and no Zig runtime linkage; parent runs all builds/tests/lint/corpus validation
constraints: Read the source Ghostty worktree only; do not modify it
Do not run formatting, builds, tests, lint, benchmarks, or the oracle in this slice; parent runs gates once
Do not touch mr-crabs-terminal osc/dcs/apc dispatch (owned by S6); mr-crabs-graphics is self-contained and exposes GraphicsHost as the integration seam
Cargo.lock regeneration (flate2/libc/png fetches) is a parent gate step

Divergences from the oracle (documented in code): max_placements count bound; Rust allocation failure aborts instead of returning ENOMEM responses (all bounds make OOM unreachable except try_reserve paths which map to OutOfMemory); iterm File= implemented beyond the oracle's unimplemented key
